title: A title bar on the timeline has a right-click menu
goal: Right-clicking a title or any placed layer on the timeline offers what you would do to it there (start here, end here, fade, delete), the way a clip bar already does, so the Time section can drop its two buttons.
notes: Found in the-video-properties-look-like-the-rest-of-the-d: SpeedInspector.placedInTime still has a Playhead row with Start Here and End Here because a placed layer bar has no .contextMenu (clip bars get TimelineClipMenu in ClipPiecesBar). EditorState startPlacedLayerHere/endPlacedLayerHere/setPlacedLayerFade already exist.
acceptance: Right-clicking a title bar on the timeline opens a menu with Start at Playhead, End at Playhead, a Fade submenu, Duplicate and Delete
The Start Here and End Here buttons leave the Time section
A walk right-clicks a title bar, chooses End at Playhead, and reads the On screen row back
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: digest 2026-09-24: same pattern on clips: the Detach Audio button is still in the panel beside the clip's right-click Detach Audio (linked-sound audit). Actions live where you click, so it leaves the panel along with Start Here and End Here.

Reproduced first: a title bar already had the shared clip menu (11 rows) but no Start at Playhead, End at Playhead or Fade. Added those three rows (EditorState+TitleTime placedLayerMenuRows, checks pushed into PhotonzCore Layer.canStartPlaced/canEndPlaced/canSetTitleFade with tests), removed the Playhead row from the Time section, moved drawn-shape-gets-a-timeline-row-walk off End Here onto the menu. Harness: a rightClick picture on a still-hidden window came out as the menu over blank white; openRowMenu now shows the window for the shot the way capture does. Detach Audio (digest note) had already left the panel. Left rough, not filed (nits, nobody stopped by them): no ⌥Q/⌥W Trim to Playhead keys on a title so the rows print none; Split at Playhead still offered on a title (pre-existing).

Title bars on the timeline now right-click to Start at Playhead, End at Playhead and Fade (plus the clip menu's Duplicate/Delete); Start Here/End Here left the Time section. Checks in PhotonzCore with tests; title-bar-right-click-menu-walk passes at Next defaults and reads the clip line back; menu pictures on a hidden window now show the window. Full suite green (10,178). Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-27-title-bar-right-click-menu.json. Commit 3c4b1be5.
